text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This diamond is of flawless clarity! Satono Diamond has triumphed in the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond didn't even give her opponents a chance! She ran as beautifully as always.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Her run today reminds me of the rapid progress Kitasan Black made last year. Or maybe she's improved even more than that…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I know Kitasan Black isn't just gonna accept defeat. Their rivalry is far from over!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Both Kita and Dia are getting so much better!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In which way do you mean exactly? …Not that I don't agree.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Watching them race kinda reminds me of our own duel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You mean at the spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Perhaps that will be their next race as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Maybe! By the way…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I reeeaaally feel like running right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh? What a coincidence. So do I.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Let's race back to the station on our way home!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'd like that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Arghhh! I'm so frustrated! It was my goal to win all the traditional senior-year races!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I messed it up in the very first race! Gaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: C-calm down, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I just couldn't pull away from you! You have no idea how hard I trained for today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And you still caught up to me! Or I should say you surpassed me. I let my guard down when it mattered most!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Arghhh! But I knew you had it in you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It takes everything I have to not fall behind you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm glad we could have an all-out race! I wanna run with you more!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I wanna beat you when you're at your best! So… I want you to enter the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho… So you're aiming for a consecutive win?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yep! At 3,200 meters, it's the longest G1 race. I wanna run it with you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Talk to your Trainer and give it some thought.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you in Kyoto!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer… About my next race…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! …But how did you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond said she wanted to pursue Kitasan Black while thinking about what it means to be illustrious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Kitasan Black is her goal, it stands to reason that she'd want to enter the same races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And knowing Satono Diamond, she'd have extra motivation for the spring Tenno Sho, a race where Kitasan Black excels and is aiming for consecutive victories.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You see right through me. Hm… If that's the case, it shouldn't be a problem if I decide things on the spot next time.
choice_data_list: I'd rather we at least discuss it first!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm just kidding. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Next is the spring Tenno Sho. I'd like to bring the honor of a win in that legendary race to the Satono family.
